adjudication.query: WITH relevant AS ( SELECT source_path, image_px, n_images, engine, mean_ms, is_valid, note FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE is_valid = TRUE AND n_images = 1 AND source_path IN ('/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/aic_multires.json','/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/fn_multires.json') ), paired AS ( SELECT image_px, MAX(mean_ms) FILTER (WHERE engine = 'aic') AS aic_pred_ms, MAX(mean_ms) FILTER (WHERE engine = 'eager') AS eager_meas_ms, MAX(mean_ms) FILTER (WHERE engine = 'compiled') AS compiled_meas_ms, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE engine = 'aic') AS pred_denominator, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE engine = 'eager') AS eager_denominator, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE engine = 'compiled') AS compiled_denominator FROM relevant GROUP BY image_px ) SELECT image_px, aic_pred_ms, eager_meas_ms, compiled_meas_ms, pred_denominator, eager_denominator, compiled_denominator, ROUND((eager_meas_ms / aic_pred_ms)::numeric, 4) AS eager_gap_x, ROUND((compiled_meas_ms / aic_pred_ms)::numeric, 4) AS compiled_gap_x FROM paired ORDER BY image_px
